AppliesTo.description:
What a rule checks, in the drawing model's words (room types as MarkView.room_type,
element classes as the drawing model's). Room ops: the rooms of `room_types`, but not one
whose printed label is one of `skip_labels` (a dining nook typed living). door_width:
`element_classes` ["door"], only the doors that meet a room of `room_types` (every door when
empty) and none of `not_room_types`. A takeoff rule may name types or classes (for the
screen).
AppliesTo.title: AppliesTo

Check.description: The double-check request on an answer that is not certified.
Check.title: Check

CheckMark.description:
An item a result is about, drawn on its page. subject: the room or door checked; counted:
what was counted for it (a room's windows).
CheckMark.title: CheckMark

CheckResult.title: CheckResult

Clause.description: Where a limit comes from: the clause someone read, the page it is on, and its sentence.
Clause.title: Clause

ConflictValue.description: answer_v1.1: one of the values two methods measured for the answer, with its evidence.
ConflictValue.title: ConflictValue

Description.description: Step 2, for a file that is not a floor plan: what the picture shows, in words.
Description.title: Description

Disputed.description: One place to double-check, as the answer gives it.
Disputed.title: Disputed

DrawingEntry.description: One drawing of a project: one per group of renderings of the same plan.
DrawingEntry.title: DrawingEntry

Edit.description: One review edit (POST /drawings/{id}/review). `reset` without a quantity resets them all.
Edit.title: Edit

IssueLinks.description: API paths to open the issue; None where there is nothing to open.
IssueLinks.title: IssueLinks

MarkView.description:
One mark as the screen draws it. `n`: its number on the drawing, None when not counted.
`value`: its share of the quantity (1 in a count, the room's m2 in an area), None: unknown.
`label`: the room's printed label, else the element class; `ref`: the element or room id in
the drawing model; both None when the mark is no item of the model (an added mark).
MarkView.title: MarkView

Normalised.description:
How an image was brought into the frame every page size, box and served page is in:
EXIF orientation applied, then any turn, deskew or perspective correction. The pipeline
reads the normalised image, never the upload's bytes.
Normalised.title: Normalised

Overrule.description: A person's call on a file's relevance; the judge's own verdict stays as it was.
Overrule.title: Overrule

ProjectView.description: Ingest's project status, plus the project's drawings, one per plan.
ProjectView.title: ProjectView

QuantityConflict.description:
Stage 10: the drawing's conflict entry (stage 8) about one quantity of the takeoff, in
that quantity's unit: every method's value, and the rule that picked one (None: no rule
decides). `derived`: how the values were carried over from another entry, when they were.
QuantityConflict.title: QuantityConflict

ReadAsPlan.description: A person's call that a file triage set aside is a floor plan: it was read as one.
ReadAsPlan.title: ReadAsPlan

Reader.description: How a drawing was read: its route, the file it was read from and that route's reader.
Reader.title: Reader

Refusal.description: Why a question gets no number, for a person, with questions this drawing can answer.
Refusal.title: Refusal

Relevance.description: Step 3, once the project's plans are read: does the described file belong to it.
Relevance.title: Relevance

RelevanceRequest.description:
A person's call on a triaged file's relevance (decision 0010). `by` as a sign-off's;
`undo` takes the call back and, like unsettle, needs nothing else.
RelevanceRequest.title: RelevanceRequest

Row.description: One quantity of the takeoff with its review state.
Row.title: Row

RuleCheck.description:
One rule on one drawing: fail when a result fails, else cannot tell when one is, else
pass. With no results: cannot tell when the drawing could not be checked (what the rule needs
was not read), not_applicable when it has nothing the rule applies to.
RuleCheck.title: RuleCheck

RulePackView.description:
A pack as GET /api/info lists it, for the country picker: the flag from `country`, the
country's name, the pack's name and law line, and every rule with the clause it quotes.
RulePackView.title: RulePackView

RuleView.description:
A rule as the pack states it. `op` is the machine check type, never shown; `comparison`
is machine (">="), `comparison_text` the words the screen shows ("at least").
RuleView.title: RuleView

ScaleView.description: The sheet's scale as read. `ratio`: N of a printed "1:N", None when the text is no ratio.
ScaleView.title: ScaleView

Scope.description: The filters of a takeoff key, parsed, so the screen can group rows without parsing keys.
Scope.title: Scope

SecondCount.description: What the second method did on a drawing: quantities it measured and where it disagreed.
SecondCount.title: SecondCount

Settled.description: The value a surveyor chose to keep for a quantity (the `settle` action).
Settled.title: Settled

Signal.description:
A raw score a reader gives an answer, named for what it is. Not a probability that the
answer is right: `calibrated` says whether it was checked against right answers (never yet).
Signal.title: Signal

Skipped.description: A file ingest set aside, with the reason.
Skipped.title: Skipped

Suggestion.description: A question the parser is checked to map to `quantity`, so asking it is never refused.
Suggestion.title: Suggestion

Triage.description:
FileStatus.triage: what triage made of an image file (decision 0010). Build a changed one
with `model_validate`, not `model_copy`, so `verdict` follows `overruled` and `relevance`.
Triage.title: Triage

TriageRequest.description:
A person's call that a file triage set aside is a floor plan (decision 0010): it is read
as one. `by` as a sign-off's.
TriageRequest.title: TriageRequest

post.description:
A person says whether a file triage set aside belongs to the project, or takes that back
(`undo`; with no call made, nothing changes). The file stays set aside either way: a call
is no reading. 409 until the project is done; 422 `no-description` for a file triage did
not describe.

A person has a file triage set aside read as a floor plan: it is read in the background,
alone, while the project stays done. Returns the file, queued; poll the project. 409 until
the project is done or while a file of it is read again; 422 `not-triaged` for a file triage
did not set aside as not a floor plan. No undo: a reading is not unread.
